scope: Post-main exploratory follow-up; separate from the evidence frozen on 2026-10-26. No expansion beyond the existing 14,060-structure dataset and frozen parent split.

configurations.action: reuse existing frozen checkpoints; no retraining

training.objective: CE + lambda_js * Jensen-Shannon divergence on two independently rendered views of the same parent structure
training.checkpoint_selection: highest mean single-factor OOD Macro-F1 across the six named Validation profiles; tie-break by higher in-range Macro-F1, then earlier step. RRUFF and Test are not used for selection.

evaluation.simulated_test_split: existing 2,109-parent Test split; already used by the frozen main study, therefore supplementary post-main only
common_panels: V9 Gaussian panels for all three configurations
V10 pseudo-Voigt/Caglioti panels for all three configurations
evaluation.real_test: RRUFF Real-PXRD-70 frozen external test, 70 spectra, exactly once after all checkpoint hashes and validation selection are frozen
evaluation.real_test_preprocessing: existing contract: 10-80 degrees 2theta, 0.02 degree step, 3,501 points, linear interpolation, zero fill out of range, max normalization, no baseline/smoothing/manual edits
evaluation.authorization: User request on 2026-11-03 explicitly asks for RRUFF Accuracy and Macro-F1 under the existing protocol and states that the test set must not be used for model selection. Evaluation will occur only after checkpoint hashes are frozen.

stopping_rule: After this three-configuration comparison and report, stop. Do not launch 100k CIF expansion, broad hyperparameter tuning, or architecture search.

direct_launch_note.hypothesis: weaker stage-3 downsampling preserves XRD peak information
direct_launch_note.changes_from_baseline: stage transitions 4/4/4 -> 4/2/4 ONLY; residual kernel stays 9
direct_launch_note.baseline_run: resnet18gn_v10/seed_20260711, selected Val OOD F1 0.70899 at step 30800
